Container.Name: GameVault
Container.Overview: Self-hosted game screenshot manager. Import your Steam screenshots (dated by when you took them), back up Steam and Special K captures from your gaming PC automatically with the GameVault Sync Windows app, keep HDR JPEG XR / 16-bit PNG originals with tone-mapped previews, and browse by game or timeline with full-text search, annotations, a public gallery and share links with Discord/Slack previews. Back up the database before updating: some releases migrate it one way.
Container.Changes: ### 1.2.3 (2026-11-23) Steam imports are dated by capture time, not upload time; older imports are corrected in the background. One-way database migration: back up first. ### 1.2.2 (2026-11-23) Fixes from an outside review: public gallery covers, merged games keep their Steam ID, no more white specks in some JXR captures, a reload prompt instead of a blank page after updates. New optional Force Ownership Fix setting. ### 1.2.1 (2026-11-09) Full-size JXR/TIFF works with a password set, plus audit fixes. ### 1.2.0 (2026-10-28) Steam JPG and Special K JXR/PNG copies of one shot are grouped as one capture; full-resolution JXR/TIFF. Run Settings, Repair image cache once after updating.
Container.Description: Self-hosted game screenshot manager. Steam and Special K (HDR) import, GameVault Sync for Windows, manual upload, annotations, full-text search, timeline, public gallery and share links.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the GameVault web interface. If another container already uses 8080 on the host, map a different host port (for example 8088) and use it in Base URL too.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Stores the database, config, and thumbnails. Use your appdata share.

Config.Name: Screenshot Library
Config.Description: Where full-size screenshots are stored. Can point to your array for large collections.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Random string used to sign auth tokens. Generate one with: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: The address people use to open GameVault, including the host port you mapped above. Share links are built from it, so they break if it is wrong. Example: https://screenshots.yourdomain.com or http://192.168.1.100:8080

Config.Name: Disable Auth
Config.Description: Set to true to disable password authentication. Only recommended for LAN-only setups behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Steam API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Enhances game metadata during Steam import. Get one at: https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey

Config.Name: SteamGridDB API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Provides higher-quality cover art. Get one at: https://www.steamgriddb.com/profile/preferences/api

Config.Name: IGDB Client ID
Config.Description: Optional. Fallback metadata for non-Steam games. Get credentials at: https://api-docs.igdb.com/#getting-started

Config.Name: IGDB Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional. IGDB/Twitch client secret (paired with Client ID above).

Config.Name: Import Rate Limit (ms)
Config.Description: Delay between Steam requests during import. Lower = faster but may hit rate limits.

Config.Name: Max Upload Size (MB)
Config.Description: Largest single file accepted from the browser or GameVault Sync. HDR captures (JXR, 16-bit PNG) are often 30-100 MB each.

Config.Name: Import Concurrency
Config.Description: Images decoded at once per game during Steam and Special K imports (1-16). Each large JXR needs about 200 MB of RAM while decoding.

Config.Name: Max Upload Batch Size (MB)
Config.Description: Largest single upload request, all files together.

Config.Name: Max Files per Upload
Config.Description: Most files accepted in one upload request.

Config.Name: Preview Max Width
Config.Description: Width of the preview image the viewer loads first (800-7680). Originals are never changed.

Config.Name: Thumbnail Quality
Config.Description: JPEG quality for generated thumbnails (1-100). Higher = better quality, larger files.

Config.Name: Token Expiry (Days)
Config.Description: How long login tokens remain valid before requiring re-authentication.

Config.Name: Special K Allowed Folders
Config.Description: Comma-separated container paths the server-side Special K importer may scan, e.g. /data/specialk. Required if Disable Auth is true. Not needed for GameVault Sync.

Config.Name: Extra CORS Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated extra origins allowed to call the API. Only needed if the web UI is served from a different host.

Config.Name: Force Ownership Fix
Config.Description: true re-owns every file under /data on each start. Leave false so array disks don't spin up on every start; use it once after copying files into the library as root.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone. Affects date display in the UI.
